description: VauPrime connects ChatGPT to a user's VauPrime accounting workspace. Users can securely view organizations, customer details, complete account ledgers, product information, live stock status, and high-level business summaries. Access is authenticated through VauPrime OAuth and scoped to the user's authorized organizations. Current plugin actions are read-only and do not create, edit, or delete accounting records.
